notes.title: Development through 2025
notes.content:
This is a long one but if you play at least once a week you should read so you have an idea of what's going on.

The Test Branch change done to Pro Mods and Radial 315 are to my liking (ignoring the braking issue) and I am satisfied with it.
What actually changed? 
The grip levels were untouched, however tires are now very punishing if your car spins too much, it will want to kick out to the wall. This makes it so no longer can someone pull up with a tune that spins to the 330 and still goes rounds (As I have done in the past). Some people's turns are unaffected as they never spun before, but some like me had to really change the power management to stop spinning and be able to get down the track straight. 

This change will be applied to all cars (one or two classes at a time, and after I fix the incontrolable braking), however doing so now would yield no change, the difference is only felt in conditions where there's more power than grip, which only pro mods can really do right now. All other classes are going to see changes gradually through the coming weeks, starting with Pro Imports and Outlaws. It will take time but every class is gonna get grip removed. I am very dissatisfied with the tuning on classes like Imports, Limited Street, Pro Stock, because they have more grip than power and become just putting all the sliders to max and driving it perfectly every race. I do not want this to be the case and as such I will be making core changes to each class to lower the grip to a level where it will actually take adjusting to track conditions to not spin.

This will be done as a preamble to the host tools that were teased earlier in the month. Right now these tire physics changes will still have people go down every pass because they have a tuneup for each track % where they know they won't spin  (Due to how rigid the system is) When the new weather system gets implemented, good event hosts will be changing things and mixing and matching track prep/temps/air quality, to make events feel dynamic and make people actually tune for the conditions. Sharing tunes will be a lot less effective when each race's conditions are much more unique than just a track % that works the same across tracks.

Of course, removing grip is gonna affect ETs for those classes so they will slowly be adjusted to where they should be again. This process is likely gonna take a couple of months but there will be test branches to test regularly, and in the end will result in a better game for everyone.

The game will also continue to get quality of life fixes and UI improvements for a smoother experience.
More Details in Discord.

notes.title: Bounty Drag Racing is no longer in Early Access
notes.content:
With the release of 1.0 and patch 1.1, Bounty Drag Racing is no longer in Beta. I am more than grateful to everyone who, with their support, allows me to dedicate myself to this full-time, especially the sponsors who enable me to host events with real money prizes. In total over $700 has been given to players in prizes for our events in the past 6 months (Join Discord to participate). I have made countless friendships and experiences that will stay with me, including sponsoring a car in the United States and winning one of the biggest events of the year in Tampa, currently being one of the most competitive cars in the Limited Street class.

I want to once again thank all the players, friends, and collaborators who have been part of this adventure. Your support has been key to achieving this milestone. Thank you all for making this possible and stay tuned because new content will continue to be added!

notes.title: $100 in Monthly Events Throughout 2024
notes.content: I'm still full steam ahead working on the next beta that will release as Update 13. In an effort to keep a competitive spirit in the community, I decided to host an event for $50 USD every 2 weeks. Entry is free to all players, and we rotate classes to keep people trying out new vehicles. To participate in these events all you need is to be in the Discord (accesible from the main menu) to find out when the next event is happening, and have a PayPal account to receive the funds. I've already given away $200 in prizes to players, and will continue to do so to give some support back to the community. The next of these events will be announced shortly on Discord.

notes.title: Bounty Drag Racing Pro Mod Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
The awaited Pro Mod Update is here and it includes 2 new vehicles included in the base game, and 8 DLC vehicles. The update includes new chassis and suspension dynamics that cause cars to slide sideways if too much power is applied. Other fixes include
Increased brake strength for the Top Alcohol Funny Car
Fixed lack of smoke for one of the Extreme Imports
Fixed Smoke of Diesel Engine
Better Handling for the Nitro Bike
Better First Person Camera Effects

An event was held on July 4th to practice with the new Physics.

notes.title: Bounty Drag Racing Update 0.2.0 is live
notes.content:
Added New In-Game Qualifying Tools
Added New In-Game Bracket Tools
Fixed Wheelie Bars causing Sparks on some Outlaw Cars
Added Ability to move First Person camera by Right Clicking and moving the mouse
Added new Immersive First Person camera with Helmet and visual effects
Added ability to move the camera with controllers
Fixed the camera positions for the Top Fuel Bike
Lowered Effects of Weather by 50%
